channel.title: The Daily Herald of Everett, Washington - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Daily Herald of Everett, Washington (heraldnet.com)

item.title: Public Works accepting proposals for Granite Falls Bridge donation
item.description: For almost a century, it has served as a vital river crossing. Soon, it will be replaced and have a new home.

item.title: Blooming in the rain
item.description: Mill Creek gardener Paula Dickman shares art of growing roses in the Pacific Northwest.

item.title: Plane crashes into hanger on Saturday at Harvey Airfield
item.description: The two occupants of the plane were uninjured. A second aircraft was damaged inside the hangar.

item.title: For Rivian and Lucid, path finally emerges for direct-to-consumer car sales in WA
item.description: Legislation in the state Senate would put the companies on the same footing as Tesla. It has support from auto dealers, who have opposed the change previously.

item.title: Diver dies following distress call Saturday morning
item.description: Mukilteo fire crews attempted life-saving care, but the diver was pronounced dead at the scene.

item.title: Editorial cartoons for Monday, March 2
item.description: A sketchy look at the news of the day.

item.title: Comment: Corporations are making more while workers enjoy less
item.description: GDP is at record levels, as is CEO compensation. But worker pay, benefits and sentiment are lagging.

item.title: Comment: President Trump is losing his coveted ‘Bro’ vote
item.description: Generation Z males are bailing on Trump because he hasn’t delivered as he promised on affordability or jobs.

item.title: Comment: Who pays if Supreme Court shields Big Oil on climate?
item.description: Grab a mirror. Insurers, local governments and taxpayers will get stuck with costs of climate disasters.

item.title: Vote for The Herald’s Prep Athlete of the Week for Feb. 22-28
item.description: The Athlete of the Week nominees for Feb. 22-28. Voting closes at midnight Sunday. The winner will be announced with the next poll and in next Wednesday’s paper.
